transcript: If you have a super long Claude chat, number one, you're hitting your usage limits frequently. And number two, you cannot continue chatting in the same chat anymore. So go to your chat and prompt, create a markdown file for this chat. So it will synthesize your chat and provide you with the .md file. Once you get a file, download and upload it to a new chat. And then you can continue chatting in the new chat without hitting your chat or usage limits. So don't forget to follow and save this reel.
caption: Two Claude problems nobody talks about: hitting your usage limits, and getting locked out of long chats (which means losing all your context). Here’s how to fix both.
